en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional revolutionary song about Gotse Delchev. The last two lines are unclear: 'потера да дадам' I read as 'to send a pursuit/posse', but it may mean the bey's son wants to hide in the forest; my reading.

lines.en: Unfurl, forest, green forest,
make shadows, thick shadows,
make shadows, thick shadows.
From below comes Delchev the voivode,
with seventy-seven heroes,
with seventy-seven heroes.
Straight he crosses the Solun plain,
the Solun plain, a wide plain,
the Solun plain, a wide plain.

lines.cyr: Редум по редум, евеј се редат,
lines.lat: Redum po redum, evej se redat,
lines.en: Row after row they line up,
as if passing by the beys' estates,
as if passing by the beys' estates.

lines.cyr: Па ми и догледа младото бегче
lines.lat: Pa mi i dogleda mladoto begče
lines.en: And the young bey's son caught sight of them

lines.cyr: и си нарамува пушка на рамо,
lines.lat: i si naramuva puška na ramo,
lines.en: and slung a rifle over his shoulder,

lines.cyr: и си нарамува пушка на рамо.
lines.lat: i si naramuva puška na ramo.
lines.en: and slung a rifle over his shoulder.
And he says to the forest, speaking:
- Unfurl, forest, green forest,
unfurl, forest, green forest.
Make a thicket, a green thicket,

lines.cyr: и јас да одам в' гора зелена,
lines.lat: i jas da odam v' gora zelena,
lines.en: so that I too may go into the green forest,

lines.cyr: потера да дадам за Делчев војвода.
lines.lat: potera da dadam za Delčev vojvoda.
lines.en: to raise a posse for Delchev the voivode.
